head: codex/g2-n6-f1-source-gate
title: G2-N6-F1-A: fix official source binding and separate coverage certification
body:
RoboCasa fixtures store identity in dictionary keys and often only cls in the value, so the previous record.name check rejects genuine fixtures. This patch accepts strict official fixtures/object_cfgs identity and category provenance and keeps declared subset completion separate from reviewed full-scene source scope.

Fixed implementation: `7c12caea2c0a4b9acc24d40da9e7c5a5345888f3`; base handoff `f1e4f1f0e3f2a48c3361987fabf58e406b313c7b`. Native remains `2009fae35d86579bb22c273fb97ec1bf0835b533`; Gitlink remains `1ca308055fc41fb69efaeb9efaa23808f164a18e`. Related to #26. Keep Draft and unmerged.

- Strict RFC6901/key/name/category/role checks; full compiled geom/body/material/world-pose/color audit.
- Legal subset COMPLETE remains DECLARED_VISUAL_GEOMS_ONLY. Normal plans require source/role/material review or explicit subset diagnostic mode.
- Native-run scope fields cannot grant certification. Capture/load/render revalidate actual sealed source manifest/review/precolored artifacts against the initial native input and source identity.
- Same 31 frozen tests: old 17 fail/14 pass → new 31 pass. Full G2 Python129/129 pass, zero failures/errors/skips; source hashes read back exactly. No native source or Catkin change.
- Real Layout1/10 four-frame/whole-house materials, native structures #8, genuine model execution and six-view H1 remain pending. No server file access/transfer, GPU, PSS/Cosmos, production refs or training.
